transcript.content: Hello, welcome in—I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I just don’t care about anything anymore. I used to do art classes, board-game nights, hiking... I was thinking about getting back on the soccer team, but now I just sit in my room and let everything slip away.
How long have you been feeling this way—when did you first notice you stopped caring about these activities?
I’m not really sure when it started. It feels like it’s been building—I just gradually stopped going to art, board games, hiking... even soccer. Now I mostly just stay in my room and let things go.
Can you tell me roughly how many weeks or months it's been since you first started losing interest in these activities?
I honestly can’t pin it down to a certain number of weeks or months. It’s been gradual—one by one I stopped doing the art classes, board games, hiking, all of it.
Would you say you've been feeling this way, with little interest or motivation, more or less continuously for the past two years or longer?
I can’t really say it’s been two years. I just know I don’t care about any of it now—the art classes, board-game nights, hiking, even soccer. I mostly sit in my room and let everything slip away.
Before you started losing interest in these activities, was there a particular stressful event or life change—like a breakup, job loss, or family issue—that happened around that time?
I don’t know. I can’t think of one specific thing that happened around then. It just kind of faded over time.
Along with losing interest in things, have you also been feeling sad, empty, or hopeless most of the day?
Most days, yeah. I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It feels like there’s no future for me outside these apartment walls.
Have you ever had a period, lasting several days or more, when you felt unusually energetic, elated, irritable, or needed much less sleep than usual?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed times where I felt unusually energetic or needed a lot less sleep.
Have you ever had a period like this before—weeks or months of low mood and loss of interest—at some earlier point in your life, followed by a time when you felt back to your normal self?
I don’t really know. Most days I just wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling, like there’s no future for me outside these apartment walls.
Thinking back over your life, has there ever been a time before now when you felt completely back to your normal self, without this heavy, empty feeling, for weeks or months at a stretch?
I can’t really remember feeling completely back to normal for that long. Most days I still wake up with that heavy, empty feeling, like there isn’t anything beyond these apartment walls.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to hurt yourself or of not wanting to be alive?
Yeah. I keep thinking I don’t want to wake up anymore. When my friend found me, I’d been saying out loud that I couldn’t keep living like this.
Has this heavy, empty feeling been present nearly every day, without a break of more than two months at a time, for the last two years or longer?
Yeah... it’s there most days. I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest, like there’s no future for me beyond these apartment walls.

Before you started feeling this severe—having thoughts of not wanting to wake up—had you been feeling a milder, low-grade sadness or lack of energy that lasted for at least two years, which then recently got much worse?
I’m not sure. I know I’ve felt low for a long time, but I can’t really tell when it changed or whether it was like that for two full years before it got this bad.
Has this current heavy, hollow feeling with thoughts of not wanting to wake up been present nearly every day for at least the past two weeks?
Yeah. It’s been like that every day lately—waking up with that heavy, hollow feeling, like there’s nothing beyond these apartment walls.

Setting aside how you feel now, can you recall any earlier time in your life—separate from this current period—when you felt depressed and lost interest in things for two weeks or more, and then that feeling fully lifted and you went back to your usual self?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of a separate time where I was depressed for weeks and then completely got back to feeling like myself afterward.
